card.name: Switching between products or formulations
card.fires_on: Words in dosing text about switching or changing from one drug or formulation to another, such as switching, changing, converting, and the word just before 'from' or 'between'. Also fires on some partway-through-word pieces such as concom-it-antly.

modes.description: Verbs or linking words that introduce a change from one product or formulation to another.
